description: This file is a release automation script written in Bash. It handles version bumping, component metadata updates, and integration with GitHub PR labels for a specific project.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays help message for using the release script.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs informational messages to standard output.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs warning messages to standard error.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and terminates the script.

methods.name: component_from_path
methods.description: Determines the component directory based on a file path.

methods.name: is_doc_like_path
methods.description: Checks whether a given path is documentation-like or metadata-related.

methods.name: get_pr_for_commit
methods.description: Retrieves the pull request number associated with a commit.

methods.name: get_pr_labels
methods.description: Fetches labels associated with a pull request.

methods.name: compute_next_versions
methods.description: Computes the next version and generation based on current version and bump type.

methods.name: update_metadata
methods.description: Updates version and generation fields in a metadata YAML file.
